Orchestrator interface for creating a Workflow that will run a ReliabilityMlModelScenario.
An scenario is a process where the user can emulate the Feature data for a ReliabilityMlModel
(See field ReliabilityOrchestrator.ModelScenarioProcess.Spec#featureOutputData), over a TimeRange
(See fields ReliabilityOrchestrator.ModelScenarioProcess.Spec#timeRange).
General steps are:
Convert ReliabilityOrchestrator.ModelScenarioProcess.Spec#featureOutputData into Data.
For any missing Feature, retrieve their data for the given time range, and merge it with the generated
Data.
Use the ReliabilityMlModel#pipeline and the Data generated to execute:
MlPipeline#process: To generate the algorithm outputs (alerts, risk score, feature outputs, etc).
MlPipeline#interpret: To generate the feature contribution (alert feature contribution).
Transform the MlOperationRuns outputs into the structured defined at ReliabilityMlModelScenario and
store them as Data.Persisted.
Workflow Diagram:
flowchart LR
  subgraph Workflow
    direction TB
    A[\Start/] --> B1["BaseModel#process"]
    A --> B2["Convert Mock Features to Data"]
    B1 --> C["Build Pipeline xFeatures"]
    B2 --> C
    C --> D1["Pipeline Process"]
    C --> D2["Pipeline Interpret"]
    D1 --> E["Parse pipeline results"]
    D2 --> E
    B1 --> E
    E --> F["Store the scenario data"]
    F --> z[\End/]
  end
  Workflow --> h["finallyVertex: handle workflow run status (cancelled/failed/completed)"]
